what: The plan says empty --repo is treated as no repo, but the current argv parser rejects an explicit empty --repo value before the proposed validate_repo call can run.
scenario_or_breakage: Docs or tests may claim `--repo ""` falls back to the hub default, while direct users actually get a structural argv failure with no PUBLISH_OK stream; in-repo callers already omit empty repos via `${REPO:+--repo "$REPO"}`.
suggested_fix: Keep the minimum change: document and test omitted --repo as the hub-default path, and treat explicit empty --repo as invalid/required-value exit 1 rather than changing the parser to accept it.
